name: Dacia Grayber

bio.statement: Her official legislative page has Grayber describing a career as a firefighter.
bio.excerpt: As a firefighter, I have spent my life serving the community, one call at a time.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: Her official page describes House District 28 as parts of Southwest Portland, Garden Home, Hillsdale, Raleigh Hills and Beaverton.
bio.excerpt: Our house district is made up of parts of Southwest Portland, Garden Home, Hillsdale, Raleigh Hills, and Beaverton.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Grayber lists her occupation as professional firefighter-paramedic and state representative, with a background in emergency management and education.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Professional Firefighter-Paramedic, State Representative Occupational Background: Emergency Management, Educator

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 49

bio.statement: Grayber lists a B.S. in homeland security and emergency management from Concordia University and Columbia University.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: B.S, Homeland Security/ Emergency Management, Concordia University; Columbia University

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 49

bio.statement: Grayber lists precinct committee person as her prior governmental experience.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: In her 2024 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Grayber said Oregon should protect its future through climate resilience.
positions.excerpt: Let's protect Oregon's future through climate resilience

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Grayber said communities suffering from addiction should be helped to heal.
positions.excerpt: Let's heal our communities suffering from addiction.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Grayber said the state must work to elevate the lives of working families.
positions.excerpt: We must work relentlessly to elevate the lives of working families.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: Grayber says she will keep fighting for climate legislation to keep Oregonians safe and communities resilient.
positions.excerpt: Climate change is here. I'll continue fighting for innovative legislation to keep Oregonians safe and communities resilient.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Grayber says Oregonians deserve generational stability and safe, affordable places to call home.
positions.excerpt: Struggling Oregonians deserve generational stability, and safe, affordable places to call home.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Grayber says she is fighting for neighborhood schools with needed funding and accountability.
positions.excerpt: I’m fighting for the neighborhood schools our kids deserve, ensuring needed funding and accountability to deliver results.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Grayber says a fair economy is essential, citing workforce development and small business supports.
positions.excerpt: A fair economy is essential for our prosperity.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 49

positions.statement: Grayber says corporations and the ultra-wealthy must pay their fair share and that she opposes tax breaks that don't benefit working Oregonians.
positions.excerpt: Corporations and the ultra-wealthy must pay thieir fair share. No more tax breaks that don’t benefit working Oregonians.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 49

voting_record.statement: KGW reports Grayber is chief sponsor of House Bill 4113, on firefighter cancer protections.
voting_record.excerpt: Representative Dacia Grayber is chief sponsor of the bill.

source.publisher: KGW
